content: Bala sool soroya edde hibar soolor zãk

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare soiyi soiyi hoir, hite ze soolor zãkot doroza bai no gole, kintu oinno ḍak bai zai faraiyore gole, hite ekzon sur edde ekzon ḍahait.
Kintu ze doroza bai gole, hite oilde soolgunor soroya.
Doroza fahara doyaye hiballa doroza kuli de, ar soolgune hibar abaz fune, ar hibar nizor soolgunore hibaye nam dori ḍake edde fõt dehai barkule loiza.
Ar zehon hibaye hibar nizor soolgunore barkule niyolaiye, hiba hitarar age age za, edde soolgune hibar fisa lo, kiyollahoile hitara hibar abaz sine.
Kintu hitara osina ekzonor fise no loibo; bolke hitar hãsottu dái zaiboi, kiyollahoile osina mainšor abazore hitara no sine."

content: Isaye ei mesal kahanigan hitarare hoiye, kintu hibaye hitarare ki ze hoiye, hiyan hitara no buze.

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare soiyi soiyi hoir, soolgunolla ãi oilamde he doroza.
Beggun zara ãr age aišše, hitara sur okkol edde ḍahait okkol, kintu soolgune hitarare no fune.
Ãi doroza; ze ãr butottu di gole, hite uddar oibo edde butore aibo edde bare zaibo, ar sori háibolla zaga faibo.
Sur aiye šude zene hite suri, kun edde dongšo gori fare; ãi aiššyi, zene hitara zibon fa edde zaf di forefan gori fa.
"Ãi he bala soolsoroya. Bala soolsoroyaye soololla hitar nizor zibon šebi de.
Kintu betondari, ze sool soroya no, ar sool o zin hitar nizor no, ar so, hite zehon genḍa bag aiyedde deker, soolgun eri dái zargoi; toi bage hinore súlai loizagoi edde šiṛašiṭṭa goride,
kiyollahoile hite ekzon betondari, hitattu soolgunolla hono dorod nai.
"Ãi oilamde he bala soolsoroya; ãi ãrgunore sini ar ãrgune o ãre sine,
zendilla ãr Bafe ãre sine, ar ãi Bafore sini, soololla ãi ãr zibon šebi di.
Ãttu aro sool okkol ase, zin ei zãkor no, hitarare o ãttu ana foribo edde hitara o ãr abaz funibo, ar henot ugguwa zãk edde ekzon soolsoroya oibo.
Ãr Bafe ãre ador gore, kiyollahoile ãi ãr zibon šebi di, zene hiyan ãi abar uwafes firai loi fari.
Ãr foran honokiye no lor, bolke ãi nize hiyan šebi dir, ar hiyan šebi dibar kemota ãttu ase; edde hiyan abar loibar kemota o ãttu ase; ei hokum ãr Bafottu ãi faiyi."

content: Ei hota okkolor zoriya Ihudi okkolor butore abar baga bagi oiye.
Hitarar bout kiye hodde, "Hitar butore ek but ase, hite fool. Tũwara hitar hota kiyolla funor?"
Ar kiye hodde, "Ekzon bute faiya manuše endilla hota okkol no ho. Bute ki anda mainšor suk kuli di fare?"
Isa ze Allar fut hiyan Ihudi okkole ošikar goijje
Tarfore hannuka id aišše, ar hẽtte šit hal.
Isaye dórmogóror butore badša Soloimanor haissarat ãṛa ãṛi gorer.
Hẽtte Ihudi okkole hibar sairo ḍakottu zoma oiye edde hibaye hodde, "Tui ãrare ar hoto din šondot rakibi? Tui zodi Messiyah, toile ãrare ho."

content.text: "Ãi to tũwarare hoiyi, kintu tũwara biššaš no goro. Ãr bafor name ze ham okkol ãi gori, hine ãr babute goba de,
kintu tũwara biššaš no goro, kiyollahoile tũwara ãr sool no.
Ãr sool okkole ãr abaz fune, ãi hitarare zani, edde hitara ãr fisa lo.
Ãi hitarare akeri zibon di, edde hitara honodin dongšo no oibo, ar honokiye ãr hatottu hitarare hari loi no faribo.
Ãr baf, ze hitarare ãre diye, hiba oilde hár kissuttuwaro mohan, ar honokiye ãr Bafor hatottu hari loi no faribo.
Ãi edde Baf ek."

content: Hetunot Ihudi okkole hibare maribolla abar fattor feṛailoiye,

content.text: "Ãi ãr Bafor hentu tũwarare beši bala ham okkol gori dehaiyi. Hinor butore honnanolla tũwara ãre fattor mariba?"

content: Ihudi okkole zuwab diye, "Hono bala hamolla tore ãra fattor no marir, kintu kuferilla, haron tui ekzon manuš oiyore, nizore Allah dabi goror."

content.text: "Tũwarar ainot ki endilla leka nai ne, 'Ãi hoilam, tũwara allah okkol'?
Allar kalam zarar hãse aišše hitarare zodi hibaye 'Allah okkol' ho, ar Pak kitabor kalam bad oi no fare.
Henoile, zare Bafe fobitro goijje edde duniyait defeṛaiye, tũwara ki hoiba, ze 'Tui kuferi goror' kiyollahoile ãi hoilam ze 'ãi Allar Fut'?
Ãr Bafor ham zodi ãi no gori, toile tũwara ãre biššaš no goijjo.
Kintu ãi zodi gori, tũwara ãre biššaš no gorile o, hamgunore oile biššaš goro, zene tũwara zani faro edde buzi faro ze, Baf ãr butore, ar ãi Bafor butore asi."

content: Abar hitara Isare doitto kušiš goijje, kintu hiba hitarar hatottu harigiyegoi.
Tarfore Isa abar Zordanor ofarot giye, zeṛe Yahyaye torikotor gusol dito. Hiba heṛe taikke.
Bout manuš okkol hibar hãse aišše, edde hodde, "Yahyaye hono keramoti ham no gore, tarfore o kintu hibaye ei manušwar babute zin zin hoiye hin beggun soiyi."
Ar heṛe bout manuš okkol Isar biššaši oiye.
